tagline: Tell every agent. Finish steps yourself.
subtitle: Agent broadcasts, steps you finish yourself, and workflows off per workspace.

cards.title: Tell every agent at once
cards.text: An agent can send one message to every other agent of its project. You see who got it, who was busy and who was asleep.

cards.title: A step you finish yourself
cards.text: Mark a step as yours in the builder and word its buttons. The agent gives you the setup, and you answer once, on one card.

cards.title: Switch them off, per workspace
cards.text: Turn workflows off for one workspace, or for any single workflow in it, from the Workflows window. Toggle switches now slide.

also: The grid panel stays in the window
